_note: SYNTHETIC biographies of the five fictional crew members. Not real people. Each lists exposures from data/content/exposures.json (sourced risk and monitoring).

kenji.background: Commander. Military test pilot for 15 years before joining the astronaut corps.

john.background: Flight engineer. Grew up on a family farm, then worked as a mechanical engineer at an onshore wind farm. First spaceflight.

stefan.background: Flight engineer. Structural engineer before selection; ankle fracture in 2019, fully healed. First spaceflight.

amara.background: Crew medical officer. Emergency physician; one previous six-month mission on a space station.

maria.background: Mission specialist. Marine biologist with years of field expeditions at sea. First spaceflight.
